AOT cache vs AppCDS: 2,000 requests (95% CI)

aria.startup: With the AOT cache, startup was −220 ms vs AppCDS on G1 (10 of 10 rounds faster), and +70 ms on ZGC with JDK 25.
aria.training: Extra time for 2,000 requests vs a cache trained on 5,000 requests: 0 (up to onRefresh) training requests +960 ms, 200 training requests +753 ms, 1,000 training requests +447 ms, 20,000 training requests +32 ms.
aria.warmup: On G1, requests got faster sooner with an AOT cache trained with requests; the cache trained only up to onRefresh warmed up like AppCDS and default CDS.
aria.signal: During training, new classes almost stopped after about 500 requests; JIT compilations fell more slowly, with 90% done by request 5,000.
